text: 1.One recommendation letter on headed paper, signed and/or stamped2.Transcript of school exam results (completed or results so far)3.High School Certificate4.English language test score report if already received (e.g. IELTS or PTE)5.Personal statement6.One photocopy of the main pages from your passport7.One 2 inch color bareheaded photo with white background (Note: the head must occupy two thirds of the photo; photo dimension is no less than 320 × 240 pixels, the aspect ratio is 4:3; the file size is between 100kb - 500kb; jpg or jpeg format)
